use: Reference photographs for architectural features; no photographic facade projection. Photographers do not endorse this reconstruction.

photographs.name: Northern Hotel
photographs.author: Xnatedawgx
photographs.visualNotes: Four floors: tall glazed retail ground floor plus three window tiers. White/cream painted facade with shallow vertical pilasters; repeated tan panels and round/diamond medallions between upper windows. Narrow upright sash windows; black ground-floor fascia; shallow stepped flat-roof parapet and a prominent black vertical HOTEL blade with horizontal NORTHERN top. Southern party wall has a metal fire escape. Photo has a blue cast; do not sample white facade as cyan.

photographs.name: Armstrong Hotel
photographs.author: Gribeco (Kimon Berlin)
photographs.visualNotes: Three-story red brick corner block; flat roof behind shallow stepped parapet, pale coping and dark horizontal masonry band near roof. Small rectangular upper windows with striped projecting awnings; larger glazed retail ground floor and long striped awnings. Trees conceal much of elevation and signage, so use as massing/material reference rather than complete window count. City historical context independently confirms three stories, symmetric upper windows, display ground-floor windows, and flat roof with central parapet.

photographs.name: 201 Linden / Linden Hotel
photographs.author: LiquidPerson
photographs.visualNotes: Three-story red/orange brick corner building with tan stone trim and blue-gray painted metal details. Chamfered corner entrance under tall round arch; projecting polygonal bay across both upper floors with small faceted cap. Above it, a much taller pointed/pyramidal corner roof with semicircular ornament. Deep metal bracketed cornice wraps both street elevations; roof-edge cresting. Second-floor side windows have rounded stone crowns; third-floor windows have flat heads within tan bands. Photo clearly shows overhead strings and suspended circular light ring in foreground.

photographs.name: Old Town Square corner building
photographs.author: LiquidPerson
photographs.visualNotes: Three-story red brick building with a narrow chamfered/angled corner face, gray metal-clad polygonal upper bay and a black arched storefront below. Stepped brick parapet culminates in clipped-peak center panel with diamond Old Town Square emblem and a metal star above. Rectangular gold/tan framed upper windows, cream lintels, black awnings, plaza planters and contemporary lantern pole. Skeletons are seasonal decorations. Photo does not establish the whole building footprint.

photographs.name: Old Town pedestrian court / Historic District
photographs.author: Wusel007
photographs.visualNotes: Pedestrian court reference: exposed aged brick side walls with ghost lettering, dark framed sash windows and sandstone sills, two-story storefront in background with elaborate white cornice and tall narrow upper windows. Concrete paving with brick bands, low raised planters, round planters, black railings/benches, globe lamps and cafe umbrellas. Includes a prominently painted horse sculpture; use court/architectural context, not as a neutral facade texture. Predates 2015 square renovation.

photographs.name: Linden Hotel streetscape with cyclists
photographs.author: Citycommunications at English Wikipedia
photographs.visualNotes: Wider view of same 201 Linden corner confirms three-story brick mass, blue-gray corner bay/tower, tan trim, large sidewalk trees, flowers in raised/circular beds and low neighboring storefront rhythm. Strongly saturated tourism photograph; foreground cyclists and trees conceal parts of facade. Good scene composition reference; not enough evidence for surveyed footprint/dimensions.

lidar.sampling: 1.5 m COPC resolution; EPSG:26913 reprojected to local geographic coordinates; classes 1/2 used; robust inward-footprint dominant-roof estimate. No claim of 2026 survey accuracy.
